name: 2016-17 Co-Location Reporting
description:
This dataset contains 2016-17 reporting on New York City public schools that share a building with one or more other schools (co-located schools). Each of the 1,131 rows represents one school, identified by its District Borough Number (DBN), district, school name, and building ID, along with a flag for whether the school is split-sited and whether it is a transfer school.

The data includes total enrollment and enrollment broken out by grade band (PK-5, grades 6-8, and grades 9-12), plus demographic breakdowns for Asian, Black, Hispanic, White, and multiracial students, and shares of students with disabilities, English language learners, and students in poverty. Academic measures include the number of students tested in ELA and math, counts and percentages scoring proficient at levels 3-4, and graduation figures such as total graduation cohort and four-year August and six-year graduate counts, with "No Data" recorded where figures are unavailable.
